headers.comment: ORDER MATTERS: Firebase applies every matching rule and lets LATER ones override, so the broad rule goes first and the asset rule below overrides it. A '/index.html' rule alone does not work here — header rules match the REQUEST path, and every route ('/', '/learn', '/study') is rewritten to index.html rather than requested by name, so the entry point silently inherited a 1-hour default and deploys took an hour to reach returning visitors.
Hashed filenames, so these can never go stale. Cache hard.
